svg.title: Cladosporium under the microscope
svg.desc: Magnified Cladosporium: an olive-brown conidiophore rises from a hypha and ends in forked, branching chains of lemon-shaped conidia with dark scars. Inset: an olive-green to brown colony.
svg.text: CARSI · Level 2 Mould Remediation · magnified, not to scale
